verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter runs an employer-side practice covering H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E and other work visas, plus PERM and green-card strategy. It describes ongoing workforce-level services: tracking employee expirations and extensions, handling transfers, guiding cap/lottery timelines for hiring plans, and setting compliance policies as 'your workforce moves and grows.' That implies one provider can manage visas across a team, but the only documented portal is described for an individual NIW case, and there is no stated startup or scale-up program. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-case/employer dashboard or portfolio tooling, a named startup/scale-up program or volume pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team-scale delivery.
